admission.bound_method: 513 positive Taylor terms give an exact rational lower bound for exp(225/2)
admission.scope: Arithmetic implications of the existing fixed-input concentration proof; its probabilistic independence premises are not verified by this program.

arithmetic.proof_scope: Finite exact arithmetic checks; general argument: paper/appendices/fast-prepared-work.tex (lem:fast-physical-products).

batched-hasse.scope: Known public ciphertext-shaped arrays; direct versus joint Hasse transport and following algebraic states. No encryption or cryptographic sampling.

codec.scope: public plaintext codec and logical XOR counts; no encrypted execution

encoding.scope: Exact finite counterexamples to omitted privacy or full-domain correctness; not a proof of the asymptotic theorem.

fixed-field.scope: Exact finite Boolean ranks and coefficient witnesses, plus integer count formulas; no finite-to-asymptotic extrapolation.

gaussian.scope: Exact Gaussian reference recurrence, inventory and sufficient probability-budget arithmetic. No Gaussian tables, samples, primes or cryptographic keys are generated.

production_residue_minors.scope: Unit-minor arithmetic in a residue ring of the actual q3; not a primality or security certificate.

hasse.scope: Public affine identities and selected unit minors; the universal payload minimum remains a written theorem.

rational-matrix.kernel: rescaled Strassen, denominator 2, integer exact division by 8
rational-matrix.scope: Finite rational-kernel and quotient-ring packing checks, including noninvertible denominators; the fast asymptotic matrix theorem remains a written result.

worked-example.intermediate_coefficient_counterexample: f=z^4, g=z^2 gives C2=0 modulo z^8
worked-example.scope: finite plaintext arithmetic; no HE run, security claim or general proof

scope: Only the finite configurations stated in each check were executed; no coverage claim for the entire supplement.
